name: Theresa Lee
office: Walnut Valley Water District, Member, Board of Directors, Division 3

items.text: Theresa Lee has been a Walnut Valley Water District board member since 2016 and serves as Assistant Treasurer and Finance Committee chair. She owns a customs brokerage company. Her campaign says she will modernize aging infrastructure, protect water quality, and keep rates affordable.
